The '''Juzzia system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> [[Juzzian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Juzzia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
